faq_desc: The most frequently asked questions about Nomad Youth, Erasmus+, and international youth opportunities.
faq_a1: Nomad Youth is a youth platform operating locally and internationally, created to help young people find Erasmus+, volunteering, internships, training, study abroad and other development opportunities in one place. You can explore suitable opportunities, benefit from support services throughout the application process, and participate in programs and opportunities offered by Nomad Youth.
faq_q2: What are Erasmus+, Youth Exchange and ESC?
faq_a2: Erasmus+ is a European Union program supporting education, training, youth and sport. Youth Exchange is a short-term youth exchange format organized within the framework of Erasmus+. Young people from different countries come together around a specific topic, learn through non-formal methods and share their experiences. ESC stands for the European Solidarity Corps. It is a program separate from Erasmus+ that mainly offers volunteering opportunities in social, cultural and environmental fields.
faq_q3: Who can apply for Erasmus+ projects from Azerbaijan?
faq_a3: Young people living in Azerbaijan can apply for projects in which Azerbaijan is included among the eligible countries. Age limits, language requirements and other participation criteria vary from project to project. Therefore, it is important to check the specific requirements of each opportunity before applying.
faq_q4: Which costs are covered in Erasmus+ projects?
faq_a4: In most projects, accommodation, food and activity costs are covered within the project budget. Travel costs may be fully or partially reimbursed within a specified limit. In some cases, participants pay their travel expenses in advance and receive reimbursement after the project. Since financial conditions vary between projects, we recommend carefully checking the information provided in each opportunity.
faq_q5: What is Nomad Youth Erasmus+ Membership?
faq_a5: Nomad Youth Erasmus+ Membership is a 1-year membership system we created for young people who want to benefit from Erasmus+ opportunities in a more systematic way. Members are added to our participant database and may be considered during the selection process for future partner projects when their profile matches the project requirements. Membership also provides 1 year of Sending Organization support and special advantages in our other services.
faq_q6: What is a Support Organization (formerly Sending Organization)?
faq_a6: A Support Organization is a local partner organization that prepares participants for international volunteering projects and provides support throughout the process. In some opportunities, you may still see the previous term — Sending Organization. The organization's support may include providing information, preparation, necessary documents, communication with the host organization, and support after the project.
faq_q7: What is Nomad Youth Sending Organization support?
faq_a7: Nomad Youth is an organization officially registered in the Erasmus+ system and has its own Organization ID. Through Sending Organization support, you can benefit from Nomad Youth's organizational support when applying for Erasmus+ projects that require information from a sending organization.
faq_q8: Does Nomad Youth implement Erasmus+ projects?
faq_a8: Nomad Youth is building an international partnership network with organizations from different countries and is working on collaborations for new Erasmus+ projects. Our goal is to take a more active role as a partner and implementing organization in Erasmus+ projects in the future.
faq_q9: What is Nomad Youth's role in projects and the selection process?
faq_a9: Nomad Youth shares opportunities provided by other organizations on the platform and directs users to the official application pages; the selection process for these projects is carried out by the respective organization. In projects where Nomad Youth is a partner or directly involved in implementation, we may play a role in informing participants, selecting suitable candidates and implementing the project.
faq_q10: How can I share my project on Nomad Youth and become a partner?
faq_a10: If you are an organization, initiative or company creating opportunities for young people, you can contact us to share your project on the Nomad Youth platform. We are open to discussing opportunities for reaching a wider audience, joint activities and other forms of partnership.

modal_privacy_content:
Last updated: July 2026

Nomad Youth is a digital platform that helps young people more easily find Erasmus+, volunteering, internship, grant, training and other development opportunities. This document explains how your information is collected and used when you use the Nomad Youth platform, and the rules for using the platform.
Nomad Youth currently operates as an independent initiative.

1. Information we collect
During registration we may collect the following information:
First and last name
Email address
Password
Phone number
Date of birth
Areas of interest
University
Education level
Major
When you sign up with Google, basic profile information you agree to share from your Google account may also be obtained.
Information about opportunities you select, save, or mark as "applied" while using the platform may also be stored in your account.

2. How we use your information
We may use the information we collect for the following purposes:
To create and manage your account;
To show you relevant opportunities;
To help you track the projects you have saved and applied to;
To improve the platform's functioning, security, and user experience;
To respond to your inquiries and requests;
With your separate consent, to send you emails about Erasmus+, volunteering, internships, and other opportunities.

3. Email notifications
Email notifications are sent only if you have given separate consent. You can unsubscribe from email notifications at any time.

4. Sharing of information
Nomad Youth does not sell your personal information and does not share it with third parties for commercial purposes.
Information may only be used when necessary for the platform's operation, technical maintenance, security, and compliance with legal obligations.
When you apply to a project listed on the Nomad Youth platform, you are directed to that project's official application page or the organizer's form. From that point on, the information you provide is subject to that organization's own rules and privacy policy.

5. Data storage and security
Your information is stored in the database system used to operate the platform. We try to take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information.
However, it is not possible to guarantee the complete security of information transmitted over the internet.

6. Account deletion and access to information
Users can delete their account through the platform. When an account is deleted, the personal information associated with it is deleted from the system or anonymized where possible.
If you have any questions, corrections, or deletion requests regarding your information, you can contact us:
Email: nomadyouthplatform@gmail.com

7. Cookies and analytics
Nomad Youth may use cookies and similar technologies to operate the platform, improve user experience, and analyze traffic.
If Google AdSense or other advertising services are used in the future, those services may apply their own cookie and privacy rules.
modal_terms_content:
Last updated: July 2026

8. Rules for using the platform
When using the Nomad Youth platform, you must:
Provide accurate and up-to-date information;
Not use another person's account without authorization;
Not take actions that would obstruct the platform's operation, compromise its security, or cause damage;
Not copy, distribute, or use the platform's information in bulk without authorization or for commercial purposes.

9. Responsibility for projects and outcomes
Nomad Youth does not organize projects directly and only presents opportunities on one platform. Evaluating applications, acceptance or rejection decisions, running the project, payments, travel, visas, safety, and other processes are the direct responsibility of the organization running the project.
Nomad Youth does not guarantee acceptance to any project, obtaining a visa, financial support, or any specific outcome.

10. Responsibility for services
Nomad Youth may offer CV preparation, Europass CV, motivation letter, application support, Erasmus consulting, and other support services.
These services are intended to support the user during the application process and do not guarantee acceptance to any project, obtaining a visa, or any other outcome.
The terms, price, and payment method for a service are agreed upon separately once contact has been made with the user.

11. Changes
Nomad Youth may update this Privacy Policy and Terms of Use from time to time. The updated version will be published on this page, and the last updated date will be noted.

12. Contact
If you have any questions, suggestions, or requests regarding this document, you can contact us:
Email: nomadyouthplatform@gmail.com
